decisions.reason: This modular camera line has accumulated investment, is publicly visible through several models, and fits the firm's stated move toward compact and flexible sensors, so management is very likely to continue it.

The sensor suite extends established capabilities into a strategically important area, and in this R&D-intensive growing market management is likely to read any weak results as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.

Although the public commitment is weaker because the product has only been mentioned rather than strongly featured, it still matches the firm's miniaturization path and the added sunk development effort supports continued retention.
The radiation-hard camera line is close to the core business, was launched visibly with several models, and management is unlikely to reverse such a fresh and public commitment within a year.

This asteroid navigation and imaging camera is more niche and less visibly committed than the main camera lines, but it still builds on core competences and management can plausibly attribute slow uptake to long mission cycles and early-market timing.
